decisions.reason: The PETG thermoforming blank is a staple consumable in the firm's core dental laboratory business. Its performance plausibly meets aspiration, so keeping it remains the satisficing choice despite the lack of recent website evidence.

The UV-curing lacquer was only ever mentioned on the website and has not been observed since. This raises doubt about its results, but as a low-cost complementary consumable it can still be carried by the slack of a large firm.
The intraoral contrast spray supports the strategic shift toward digital scanning workflows. That justifies tolerating uncertain results rather than triggering problemistic search.
Custom earmolds rest on the firm's core skilled custom-device manufacturing for hearing-care retailers. They are unlikely to fall far enough below aspiration to warrant withdrawal.
Custom hearing protection shares earmold production capabilities and serves a growing market. Its modest uncertainty does not justify redirecting the resources.
